summary: Diagnosed pagination off-by-one defect where 1-indexed page parameter was multiplied directly into 0-indexed database offset (skip = page * page_size), causing the first 20 records to be skipped on page 1.
evidence: Symptom reproduced: GET /links/search?q=launch returned total: 2 but data: [] on page 1
Root cause isolated: skip = 1 * 20 = 20 bypassed all matching records for page 1
Fix formulated: normalize to 0-based offset using skip = (Math.max(1, page) - 1) * page_size
